div.div:
Plugin packages
Agent Plugins 1.0
git and local sources

resolve
pin versions in the lock

Lock
outputs[harness] · variants[harness]
compile[harness].inputs + compiler version
crucible-guardian locked as source: generated; sync records the result

text.tspan: crucible-guardian locked as source: generated; sync

div.div: compile · one unit per (harness, scope) · pure and byte-stable

switch.text: compile · one unit per (harness, scope) · pure and byte-stable

div.div:
normalize
fill name; Claude aliases → inherit (Droid)

dedupe
same skill twice: one is deferred

minify
descriptions over the harness cap

budget
fill the listing by priority; the rest deferred

guardian
build crucible-guardian when anything is deferred or pruned
deferred: hidden by disable-model-invocation, still invocable by name
pruned: not emitted, kept in the guardian store

text.tspan: pruned: not emitted, kept in the guardian

id, status, reasons, entry cost,
budget used and limit, inputs

forge compile
read-only report:
listing used / budget,
counts per status
--json · --check · --explain

crucible-guardian
generated plugin, one per unit
hook + MCP server
